post.summary:
Allows uploading a file for an owner (for now a workspace's icon). The asset waits for its
file; storage completes it once the upload is done. Unfinished ones are removed after a day.

404.description: No such owner, or not one the user can see

409.description: An asset with this id already exists

413.description: The file is larger than the owner allows

get.summary:
A workspace's Inbox tab: its own notifications and the handled account-level ones, which age
here with the rest (spec: Inbox · 01). The unread account-level ones are pinned apart
(`GET /notifications/account_pinned`).

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The workspace whose Inbox it is.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `nextCursor` of the previous page; none for the first page.

200.description: One page of the tab, newest first

400.description: Malformed query: no workspace, an invalid cursor

404.description: No such workspace for this user

get.summary:
The Account group pinned above every workspace's Inbox (spec: Inbox · 01): the unread
account-level notifications (an invite, a new sign-in), newest first. Shown in the Unread and
All tabs; once read, a notification leaves it for the workspace lists.

200.description: The pinned account-level notifications, newest first

404.description: No such notification of this user
No such notification of this user
No such workspace for this user
No such notification of this user
No such notification of this user

post.summary:
Creates a workspace with its built-in roles; the creator becomes its owner with Admin.
Sending the same request again (same `id`, same creator) returns the workspace with `200`.

409.description: The slug is taken, or the id belongs to another workspace

422.description: Invalid name, slug or task prefix

404.description: Slug not found

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The workspace whose address is being changed

200.description: Whether the slug can be used, and why not

404.description: Workspace not found

delete.summary:
Deletes the workspace: everyone but the owner loses it at once; the owner can restore it for
30 days, and its slug stays taken meanwhile. Deleting it again changes nothing.

404.description: Workspace not found

200.description: The workspace as it is now

404.description: Workspace not found

409.description: `EDIT_CONFLICT`: someone changed these fields since; or the slug is taken

422.description: Invalid fields, nothing to set, or a version from the future

404.description: Workspace not found

get.summary:
Every page of the workspace the user sees, flat: the client builds the tree from `parentId`,
each parent's children ordered by `position`, then `id`.

200.description: The pages, each parent's children in their order

404.description: Workspace not found

post.summary:
Creates a page, last among its siblings, with its (empty) body. The client may make the id and
the short id itself, to open the page before the answer (pages spec, creation §02); sending
the same request again (same `id`, same creator) answers with the page, `200`.

200.description: Created before by the same request

404.description: Workspace not found

409.description: The short id is taken, or the id is another page's

422.description: Invalid fields, the parent is not here, or too deep

get.summary:
Opens a page by its address, `/{ws}/p/{shortId}`. A page in the trash is answered too, with
`deletedAt`: the address is right, the page shows "This page is in Trash" (pages spec §2).

200.description: The page, live or in the trash

404.description: No such page in this workspace

delete.summary:
Moves the page, with every page under it, to the trash (pages spec §7): `restore` brings them
back for 30 days. Deleting a page in the trash changes nothing.

204.description: In the trash, now or before

404.description: Page not found

patch.summary:
Edits the title, the icon, the type — only the fields sent, each checked for a conflict on its
own (backend spec §5.3). The type changes only while the page is empty.

200.description: The page as it is now

404.description: Page not found, or in the trash

409.description: `EDIT_CONFLICT`: someone changed these fields since; `PAGE_NOT_EMPTY`: the type can no longer change

422.description: Invalid fields, nothing to set, or a version from the future

post.summary:
Puts the page, with everything under it, at `index` among the children of `parentId`. Never
under itself, never deeper than 12 levels for any page of its subtree.

200.description: The page at its new place

404.description: Page not found, or in the trash

422.description: The parent is not here, `PAGE_CYCLE` or `PAGE_TOO_DEEP`

post.summary:
Brings back a page from the trash with the pages trashed with it, at its old place. When its
parent is gone or in the trash, at the end of the root instead. A page trashed with its
parent is restored by restoring that parent (`deletedRoot`); restoring a live page changes
nothing.

404.description: Page not found, or erased from the trash

post.summary:
Brings a deleted workspace back, as it was, for every member. Only its owner, within 30 days
of the delete; then it is `404` (the layer, `load_workspace_context_with_deleted`). Restoring
a workspace that is not deleted changes nothing.

200.description: The workspace as it is now

404.description: Workspace not found, or deleted more than 30 days ago

403.description: A guest: only the owner and members with a role see them

404.description: Workspace not found

AssetOwnerType.description:
What an asset belongs to. Reading an asset is reading its owner; a new owner type comes with
its entity (and the `CHECK` of `assets.owner_type`).

ChangeSet.description: The fields of a workspace an edit sets; a field left out stays as it is.

iconAssetId.description: `null` removes the icon; leaving the field out keeps it.

hash.description: blake3 of the content, lowercase hex; the uploaded file must match it.

id.description:
Generated by the client (UUIDv7). Sending the same request again returns a fresh token
for the same asset, while it is still waiting for its file.

name.description: The file name, offered on download.

uploadToken.description: Starts the upload in storage (`POST /actions/upload/init`). Valid for a day.

workspaceId.description: The workspace it belongs to; none for an account-level one (an invite, a new sign-in).

id.description:
Made by the client (UUIDv7), so the page has its address before the server answers. The
same request again answers with the page it made. Left out: the server makes one.

parentId.description: `null` or left out: at the root, which needs `pages.create_root`.

shortId.description:
Made by the client, 10 characters of base58. Taken: `409`, make another. Left out: the
server makes one.

confirmName.description:
The workspace's name, typed by the owner to confirm. Case and the spaces around do not
matter.

EditedField.description: A field changed by someone else; a param of [`ErrorCode::EditConflict`].

at.description: When it was changed last, RFC 3339.

by.description: The user who changed it last; `None` once they deleted their account.

field.description: The API's name of the field, e.g. `slug`.

errors.description: Per-field errors, present for validation failures.

status.description: HTTP status, duplicated from the response.

trace_id.description: Correlation id to quote when reporting a problem.

type.description: Stable URI identifying the class of problem.

ErrorBody.description:
Public JSON body of every error response (`application/problem+json`).

There is deliberately no message field: clients localize from `code` and `params`.

oneOf.description: The request failed validation; see `errors` for per-field details.
The requested resource does not exist.
The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
Authentication is missing or invalid.
The caller is not allowed to perform this action.
Unexpected server failure. Details are only available in server logs.
A required field is missing. Used in per-field errors.
A field has an invalid format. Used in per-field errors.
The request could not be parsed: malformed JSON, or a body, query or path parameter of the wrong shape.
The request body has an unsupported `Content-Type`; JSON endpoints expect `application/json`.
The request body exceeds the size limit of the endpoint.
The HTTP method is not supported by this endpoint; see the `Allow` response header.
The server did not finish handling the request in time. The request may be retried.
The uploaded file exceeds the size limit.

params.description: The uploaded file exceeds the size limit.

actual_bytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

oneOf.description: The upload token is invalid, expired, or was issued to another user.
The upload transaction is not in the step this endpoint serves.

params.description: The upload transaction is not in the step this endpoint serves.

current_step.description: Step the transaction is currently in: `chunked_upload`, `whole_file_upload` or `verify_ranges`.

oneOf.description: Not all chunks of the upload have been received yet.
The size of the uploaded content differs from the size announced at upload init.

params.description: The size of the uploaded content differs from the size announced at upload init.

expected_bytes.description: Size announced at upload init, in bytes.

oneOf.description: The content hash of the uploaded file differs from the hash announced at upload init.
A chunk has a size that does not match its `Content-Range` or exceeds the chunk limit.

params.description: A chunk has a size that does not match its `Content-Range` or exceeds the chunk limit.

max_bytes.description: Maximum allowed chunk size in bytes.

oneOf.description: Too many chunks of this upload are in flight; retry shortly.

params.description: Too many chunks of this upload are in flight; retry shortly.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of chunks that may be uploaded concurrently.

oneOf.description: Ownership verification of an already stored file failed.
The server has no room left to store the file.
The signed file link is malformed, has a bad signature, or belongs to another file.
The signed file link has expired; request a new one.
A request carries more items than a single call may process.

params.description: A request carries more items than a single call may process.

max_items.description: Maximum number of items per request.

oneOf.description: A service this one depends on did not answer or answered with something unusable.
A field is longer than allowed. Used in per-field errors.

params.description: A field is longer than allowed. Used in per-field errors.

oneOf.description: A field is shorter than allowed. Used in per-field errors.

params.description: A field is shorter than allowed. Used in per-field errors.

oneOf.description:
The value must be unique and is already used, e.g. a workspace slug. Used in per-field
errors.
The user does not have the required capability to perform the action.

params.description: The user does not have the required capability to perform the action.

oneOf.description: The edit sets no field: there is nothing to change.

Someone else changed these fields after the version the edit was made on. Nothing was
applied; reload the resource and edit again.

params.description:
Someone else changed these fields after the version the edit was made on. Nothing was
applied; reload the resource and edit again.

conflicts.description: The conflicting fields, each with its latest change.

oneOf.description:
The value is not the one it must repeat, e.g. the workspace's name typed to confirm its
deletion. Used in per-field errors.
The page has content (text in its body, children, tasks): its type can no longer change.
A page cannot be moved under itself or one of its own children.
Pages cannot be nested deeper than this.

params.description: Pages cannot be nested deeper than this.

max.description: Maximum depth; a page at the root is at depth 1.

ErrorCode.description:
Every error the API can return.

Serialized as `{"code": "FILE_TOO_LARGE", "params": {...}}`; variants without data have no
`params`. Codes are a public contract: never rename one, only add or deprecate.

field.description: Name of the offending field, e.g. `avatar`.

FieldError.description: Error attached to a single request field.

roles.description: The member's roles, in their order; empty for a guest.

InboxUpdated.description: What changed, and the counts after it.

oneOf.description: A read-all: the client applies the same rule to what it has loaded.

summary.description: The unread counts after the change, to set as they are.

upserted.description: Notifications as they are now: new, folded, or read / unread / archived / unarchived.

pendingInvites.description: Invitations waiting for the user's email.

workspaces.description: Workspaces the user is a member of; there are none until workspaces exist.

index.description:
The place among the new siblings, counted without the moved page (as the kit Tree's
`onMove` gives it). Past the end: last.

parentId.description: `null`: to the root, which needs `pages.create_root` when the page comes from elsewhere.

workspaceId.description:
The workspace whose Inbox shows it; `None` for an account-level one (an invite, a new
sign-in), which every workspace's Inbox shows apart.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

PageAccess.description:
What the user may do with a page (pages spec §5). Until pages have their own grants, every
member has Full access to every page; the field is here so the frontend does not change when
they come.

PageChangeSet.description: The fields of a page an edit sets; a field left out stays as it is.

oneOf.description: `null` removes the icon; leaving the field out keeps it.
Only while the page is empty: no text in its body, no children. Else `409 PAGE_NOT_EMPTY`.
One emoji.
A Lucide icon by its name, `kebab-case`.

value.description: A Lucide icon by its name, `kebab-case`.

oneOf.description: An uploaded image. Not accepted yet: there is no picker for it.

value.description: An uploaded image. Not accepted yet: there is no picker for it.

PageIcon.description: `pages.icon`: `{ kind, value }`. No icon: the icon of the page's type.

PageNodeResponse.description: A page in the tree: what the sidebar, breadcrumbs and links draw.

position.description: Orders the siblings, compared as strings; equal ones by `id`.

version.description: `baseVersion` for a rename right in the tree.

PageResponse.description: A page as it is opened.

deletedAt.description: In the trash since. Only `by-short` and `restore` answer with a trashed page.

deletedRoot.description: The page the delete was made on: the one to restore. Itself when it was deleted on its own.

PageType.description: `pages.type` (pages spec §1.1). Changes only while the page is empty.

baseVersion.description: The `version` the edit was made on.
The `version` the edit was made on.

PinnedNotifications.description: The Account group: few by nature, so one answer and no pages.

before.description: `updatedAt` of the newest notification the user saw: what came later stays unread.

workspace.description: The workspace whose Inbox is read: the others and the account-level ones stay unread.

before.description: Those whose last event is not after this.

workspace.description: Its notifications and the account-level ones were read.

restoredToRoot.description:
Its parent was gone or in the trash: the page came back at the root instead ("Restored to
the top level").

available.description: Whether the slug can be set: `available` and `current`.

slug.description: The current slug: when it differs from the asked one, the frontend replaces the address.

StatsResponse.description:
What the workspace holds, for the texts of the Delete and Transfer dialogs: "This will delete
64 pages and 1,284 tasks for all 12 members".

members.description: Active members, the owner among them.

SummaryResponse.description:
Unread counts (spec: Inbox · 09): the sidebar's Inbox shows `byWorkspace[current] +
accountUnread`, the workspace menu a dot where that sum is above zero.

accountUnread.description: Unread account-level notifications, shown in every workspace's Inbox.

byWorkspace.description: Unread in each workspace the user is a member of; a workspace with none is absent.

authentikId.description: authentik's numeric user pk; `None` until the user sync webhook has arrived.

picture.description: `None` until the user has an avatar.

WorkspaceResponse.description: A workspace as its members see it.

deletedAt.description: Set only for the owner, while the workspace can still be restored (30 days).

iconAssetId.description:
The icon; `None` draws the first letter of the name. Public, so the frontend builds its
link itself: `{storage}/public/files/{iconAssetId}`.

isPersonal.description: Its owner's personal workspace: it can't be deleted, transferred or left.
